We have mass spec showing m/z 224.120115... likely molecular ion [M]+? The formula we guessed C16H16O has exact mass: let's compute: C16 = 16*12.0000 = 192. H16 = 16*1.007825 = 16.1252, O = 15.994915. Sum = 224.120115. Yes matches. So molecular formula C16H16O.
